answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an onyx bet on surviving 55 epochs of grading, and every haven settlement recomputes the vine schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 55 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 32 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
